## Summary

Found by the Step 7 (Axis 1 construct) sibling sweep while fixing `satiated-activated-aardwolf` (5524-e353-2e2d-4dbe). Same detect-only drift class as `CONFIG_PATHS`, but on the gerrit deploy-key materializer, which was overlooked when `materialize-g2p-config.sh` was added to `CONFIG_PATHS`.

`infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` is an SSM-to-file materializer (it puts the replication deploy key into the gerrit user's dir), a direct sibling of `infra/gerrit/materialize-g2p-config.sh`. `materialize-g2p-config.sh` IS enumerated in `CONFIG_PATHS` (detect-only, `reason=config_manual`); `materialize-deploy-key.sh` is in **no** manifest. So a merged change to the deploy-key materializer rsyncs to `/opt/rebar` and silently does nothing — the same drift class `CONFIG_PATHS` detect-only was created to make visible.

## Class-level plan (PRIMARY ticket for the manifest-omission class)

This ticket is the primary for a ONE class-level change fixing both confirmed instances of the class "an infra SOURCE that affects the running environment is absent from every path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a merged change to it drifts silently". The change touches ONLY `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (two manifest additions) plus the new/extended regression tests. Sibling ticket `5d4c-a25b-b612-4aca` (broke-choleric-hound) is fixed in the same change.

Both instances proven at runtime with a discriminating contrast against the sibling source that IS in the manifest (see RCA comments on each ticket).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` is enumerated in the `CONFIG_PATHS` literal in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (Instance 1, detect-only parity with `materialize-g2p-config.sh`; applying touches gerrit so no auto-reload).
- [x] A deploy-key-materializer-only change emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual`, asserted by a regression test extending `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`.
- [x] `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` is enumerated in the `MCP_PATHS` literal in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (Instance 2, apply-parity; ADR 0079 v1 mcp auto-apply scope).
- [x] An mcp-entrypoint-source-only change fires the existing blue-green mcp deploy path, asserted by a regression test in `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py` (`docker compose build mcp` invoked + nginx upstream flipped).
- [x] [non-codebase] Each regression test is shown RED before the fix and GREEN after, with mutation teeth: emptying the manifest entry returns the test to RED. (Process/run evidence — see the RED→GREEN + mutation-teeth comment on this ticket.)
      provenance: environment=local developer worktree (macOS, repo virtualenv, git-diff shim harness with stubbed docker, compose, and nginx commands); principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com (executing agent); privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=simulation — the regression suite drives the real autodeploy entrypoint under a simulated git-diff environment, observed failing before the manifest additions and passing after, with blanking the manifest entry returning it to failing. No AWS, gerrit, or real deploy is touched.
- [x] [non-codebase] `make lint` (including shellcheck) passes. (Run result — see the verification-evidence comment; also the Gerrit `Verified +1` lint+type-check job on change 2444.)
      provenance: environment=local developer worktree (macOS, repo virtualenv) plus GitHub Actions CI (ubuntu-latest); principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com locally and the rebar CI bot on the merge gate; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=static-analysis — ruff and shellcheck are static analyzers run with no runtime privilege, and both the local run and the CI lint plus type-check job reported clean.
- [x] [non-codebase] The full automated script-test suite for the changed autodeploy behavior passes as a CI run result. (GitHub Actions run 33333127540 pytest matrix jobs — ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13 — all green; Gerrit `Verified +1` on change 2444. Provenance also documented in the verification-evidence comment on this ticket.)
      provenance: environment=GitHub Actions CI runners (ubuntu-latest py3.11, py3.12, py3.13 and macos-latest py3.13) plus local developer worktree; principal=the rebar CI bot on the Gerrit merge gate and joeoakhart@navapbc.com locally; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=live-call — the automated suite executes for real in an isolated CI sandbox with no production access, and all matrix jobs of run 33333127540 reported green, contributing the Gerrit Verified +1 on change 2444.

## Non-goals

- `observability.sh` needs no change: it already counts every `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {` marker regardless of `reason`, so the `config_manual` signal is counted for free.
- A structural manifest-completeness guard for this class is being evaluated separately and is intentionally out of scope. Any further same-class instances found are enumerated in the final report, not filed, per the sweep-containment directive.

## Evidence

- `CONFIG_PATHS` includes `infra/gerrit/materialize-g2p-config.sh` but NOT `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh`.
- Runtime discriminating experiment: a deploy-key-materializer-only change produced NO signal; a g2p-materializer-only change produced `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual`.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` bakes `mcp-entrypoint.sh` into the image (`install -m 0755 ... mcp-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/mcp-entrypoint.sh`; `ENTRYPOINT`), yet it is absent from `MCP_PATHS`.
